purpose: Preregistered re-run of the posteriordb_bench_v3 protocol on the current sampler defaults (Tuning::default() with max_refinement_levels = 8 since WP28, STUDIES/funnel_defaults_v1) with a second oWALNUTS arm that adds DiagonalMetricRegularization::Stan to the default warmup (the `reg` remedy of WP27, STUDIES/step_collapse_v1): identical model set, gates, estimators, chains/iterations, competitor versions and settings; fresh seeds; the harness rebuilt against the current src/; arms owalnuts-da, owalnuts-da-stanreg, cmdstan, nutpie (the v3 stan-style control is dropped; its question was answered in v3 and step_collapse_v1).

predecessor.artifacts_reused: none for measurement (summary.json read only for the v3-vs-v4 comparison table); the v3 compiled BridgeStan/CmdStan models, venv and posteriordb checkout no longer exist (their worktree was removed), so every model is compiled fresh with the same BridgeStan 2.9.0 / Stan 2.39.0 / CmdStan 2.39.0 toolchain and the same flags (no STAN_THREADS); the posteriordb checkout is a fresh shallow clone at commit 28f8d3d as in v3

kernel_under_test.api: owalnuts::sampler (Sampler, Init::uniform(), Tuning::default(), Metric::diagonal(), Adaptation); harness src/main.rs identical to v3 except the stanreg arm and the recorded metric_regularization field

sampler_defaults_under_test.source: STUDIES/funnel_defaults_v1 (WP28): fixes the funnel tail bias; never engaged on Eight Schools or a 100-D Gaussian
sampler_defaults_under_test.applies_to: both oWALNUTS arms (retained and warmup transitions); the harness records tuning.max_refinement_levels in every cell and the per-chain histogram of the selected refinement level of retained transitions

sampler_defaults_under_test.source: STUDIES/uturn_default_v1 (WP26) rejected MomentumSum as default; unchanged

option_under_test.route: Adaptation::Custom(WarmupConfig::new(0.8).with_warmup_exhaustion_rule(DEFAULT_WARMUP_EXHAUSTION).with_metric_regularization(DiagonalMetricRegularization::Stan)) — the `reg` arm of STUDIES/step_collapse_v1, which is the sampler's default warmup plus this one option
option_under_test.source: STUDIES/step_collapse_v1 (WP27): 9.7x ESS/gradient on sblrc, 1.9x on earnings with the earnings gate lost (R-hat 1.02), 1.08x on three controls; kept opt-in

owalnuts-da.target: owalnuts-bridgestan ReplicatedStanTarget, 4 replicas (BridgeStan 2.9.0, Stan 2.39.0, built WITHOUT STAN_THREADS, fresh compile for this study)
owalnuts-da.starts: sampler::Init::uniform(): uniform(-2,2) unconstrained, redrawn up to 100 times until finite density and gradient; SmallRng(splitmix64(seed ^ INIT_SEED_TAG))

warmup.contents: the sampler's default dual-averaging warmup (coarse-endpoint acceptance statistic, no initial step search, restart reference at the current step, WP24 one-sided warmup exhaustion rule) with the metric regularisation switched from TowardUnit to Stan; nothing else differs from owalnuts-da

nutpie.backend: bridgestan (nutpie.compile_stan_model; nutpie builds its own STAN_THREADS library)

run_order: models in listed order; arms owalnuts-da, owalnuts-da-stanreg, cmdstan, nutpie; seeds ascending; strictly sequential
parameter_set: columns of the posteriordb reference draws; oWALNUTS draws constrained by BridgeStan param_constrain(include_tp=True)
estimators: arviz 0.23.4: rank rhat; bulk ESS; tail ESS prob (0.05, 0.95); mcse method mean

metrics.gradients_total: owalnuts target calls (start search + warmup + sampling, all chains); cmdstan sum n_leapfrog__ (warmup+sampling); nutpie sum n_steps (warmup+sampling)
metrics.wall: seconds around the single sampler call (Sampler::run, CmdStanModel.sample, nutpie.sample), warmup included, compile excluded; the oWALNUTS start search (a handful of evaluations) is outside the wall
metrics.wall_sampling_estimated: wall * gradients_sampling / gradients_total (all arms); cmdstan CSV elapsed times also recorded
metrics.ess_per_second: min over parameters of bulk (tail) ESS / wall
metrics.ess_per_gradient: min over parameters of bulk (tail) ESS / gradients_total; sampling-only variant also reported
metrics.agreement: z = (mean - mean_ref)/sqrt(mcse^2 + mcse_ref^2) with arviz mean MCSE on both sides; max |z| over parameters; flag if > 4
metrics.frozen_chain: an oWALNUTS chain with more than 500 of its 1,000 retained transitions ending in refinement exhaustion; a cell is frozen if any chain is
metrics.refined_fraction: oWALNUTS arms: fraction of the 4,000 retained transitions per cell whose selected refinement level is > 0 (from the per-chain retained_refinement_level_histogram); also the fraction at levels 5-8, which the v3 four-level default could not select

head_to_head: per (owalnuts arm, competitor): geometric mean over models with all seeds ok on both sides of the seed-median ratios of min bulk ESS/gradient, min bulk ESS/s and wall per gradient; wins counted per model; 'outright win' = gates passed >= competitor and higher seed-median ESS/gradient and ESS/s. Additionally stanreg versus da: per-model seed-median ratio of min bulk ESS/gradient on the same seeds, geomean over models where both have a median, the minimum, models below 0.8x, and 'gate lost' = a model where stanreg passes fewer seeds than da

predictions.P1: owalnuts-da passes all gates on >= 35 of 51 cells (v3: 35)
predictions.P2: owalnuts-da geometric-mean min-bulk-ESS/gradient vs CmdStan over all 17 models within 0.9-1.1x of v3's 0.344 (i.e. 0.310-0.378): eight levels are a cap these posteriors do not reach (funnel_defaults_v1), so the DA arm should reproduce v3 within seed noise; the fraction of retained transitions at refinement level > 0 (and at levels 5-8) is reported per model
predictions.P3: owalnuts-da-stanreg min-bulk-ESS/gradient >= 2x owalnuts-da (seed medians) on both sblrc and earnings (step_collapse_v1: 9.7x and 1.9x on seeds 80101-80102)
predictions.P4: owalnuts-da-stanreg geometric-mean min-bulk-ESS/gradient ratio to owalnuts-da >= 1.1 over the 17 models, and no model below 0.8x
predictions.P5: owalnuts-da geometric-mean wall per gradient <= 1.0x CmdStan (v3: 0.751)

default_decision_rule: DiagonalMetricRegularization::Stan becomes the sampler default only if the stanreg arm is >= 1.1x owalnuts-da on the geometric mean of per-model min-bulk-ESS/gradient, no model is below 0.8x, and no model loses a gate (stanreg passes fewer seeds than da on no model). step_collapse_v1 predicts the earnings gate is lost (R-hat 1.02 at the corrected metric), in which case the rule fails and the option stays opt-in.
decision_rules: Report all cells; no reruns; failures are results; nothing tuned after seeing results. A driver crash is relaunched and the interrupted cell re-run from scratch (seeded), recorded as a deviation. No default change is applied in this study; it reports the rule's outcome.
versus_v3: per model and arm: seed-median v4 / v3 ratios of min bulk ESS/gradient and ESS/s from the v3 summary.json (owalnuts-da vs v3 owalnuts-da; owalnuts-da-stanreg vs v3 owalnuts-da; cmdstan vs cmdstan; nutpie vs nutpie); geomean over models
